meta.name: bash-linux
meta.description: Bash/Linux terminal patterns. Critical commands, piping, error handling, scripting. Use when working on macOS or Linux systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在终端里执行命令、编写脚本处理系统任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常在Mac或Linux终端里敲命令。
copy.tagline_en: Use terminal commands and scripts to manage system tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work in the macOS or Linux terminal.

howto.what: Claude 会按技能内的 Bash/Linux 命令速查表提供命令示例,覆盖文件操作、进程管理、文本处理、环境变量、网络检查和脚本模板,并包含错误处理与管道用法。
howto.when: 当你在 macOS 或 Linux 系统上工作时触发,比如需要执行或解释终端命令、写脚本、排查错误时。

say.text: 帮我列出当前目录所有文件,含隐藏文件
say.note: Claude 会给出 ls -la 并解释输出。

say.text: 写一段 Bash 脚本,带错误退出和清理逻辑
用 grep 在 src 目录里搜索 TODO 注释
say.note: Claude 会给出 grep -rn 命令及说明。

howto.what_en: Claude will provide Bash/Linux command references and examples from the skill, covering file operations, process management, text processing, environment variables, network checks, and script templates, including error handling and piping.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working on macOS or Linux systems, for example when you need to run or explain terminal commands, write scripts, or debug errors.

say_en.text: List all files in the current directory, including hidden ones.
say_en.note: Claude will provide ls -la and explain the output.

say_en.text: Write a Bash script with error exit and cleanup logic.
say_en.note: Claude will output a script with set -euo pipefail and trap.

say_en.text: Search for TODO comments in the src directory using grep.
say_en.note: Claude will give the grep -rn command and explain it.
